basic_profile.bio: Based in the scenic landscapes of Sweden, I am a 35-year-old IT consultant with a passion for PC building and technology. When I'm not working on IT solutions or gaming, I enjoy exploring the vibrant culture of Stockholm and indulging in Scandinavian cuisine. I'm a night owl, often found online between 10 PM and 2 AM local time, engaging with the global Reddit community. Happily married, I share my life with my partner and our two cats, who love to snooze on my keyboard. My interests range from gaming and tech to the occasional philosophical discussion or travel planning for our next adventure.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: With a degree in Computer Science and over a decade of experience in IT consulting, I have honed my skills in hardware, software, and network solutions. My fascination with PC building started as a hobby and turned into a side gig, helping friends and online acquaintances optimize their setups.
